@@ -140,7 +140,21 @@ defmodule Gaoxy.LifecycleAcceptanceTest do
     eventually(fn -> Gaoxy.status(runtime, "tls").active == 1 end)
     assert :ok = Gaoxy.pause(runtime, "tls")
     assert %{mode: :paused, pause: :unbind_rebind} = Gaoxy.info(runtime, "tls")
-    assert {:error, _} = :gen_tcp.connect(ip, port, [:binary, active: false], 500)
+
+    # Listener-owner termination and TCP refusal are distinct barriers.
+    # Wait for the actual network barrier and close every transient probe.
+    eventually(fn ->
+      case :gen_tcp.connect(ip, port, [:binary, active: false], 500) do
+        {:error, :econnrefused} ->
+          true
+
+        {:ok, socket} ->
+          :gen_tcp.close(socket)
+          false
+      end
+    end)
+
+    assert %{state: :paused, active: 1} = Gaoxy.status(runtime, "tls")
     assert Port.command(peer, "admitted-during-pause\n")
     assert_receive {^peer, {:data, {:eol, "PASS admitted-during-pause"}}}, 2000
     assert :ok = Gaoxy.resume(runtime, "tls")

@@ -155,7 +155,15 @@ defmodule Gaoxy.RegistryFailureTest do
     instance = runtime()
     {:ok, service, _} = GenServer.call(instance, {:lookup, "udp"})
     %{backend: backend, gate: gate} = :sys.get_state(service)
-    monitors = for pid <- [service, backend, gate], do: {pid, Process.monitor(pid)}
+    {:ok, tcp_service, _} = GenServer.call(instance, {:lookup, "tcp"})
+    %{backend: tcp_backend, gate: tcp_gate} = :sys.get_state(tcp_service)
+
+    # Each service receives owner loss independently; UDP completion is not a
+    # barrier for the TCP service's reconciliation deadline or cleanup.
+    monitors =
+      for pid <- [service, backend, gate, tcp_service, tcp_backend, tcp_gate],
+          do: {pid, Process.monitor(pid)}
+
     {ip, port} = Gaoxy.info(instance, "udp").local
     tcp_local = Gaoxy.info(instance, "tcp").local
     exchange_udp({ip, port})
